title: dialect-level autocommit setting is not correctly restored from isolation level execution option

labels.name: engine
labels.description: engines, connections, transactions, isolation levels, execution options

labels.name: near-term release
labels.description: addition to the milestone which indicates this should be in a near-term release

labels.name: autocommit use cases
labels.description: links discussions where users requesting various forms of autocommit, core or ORM

body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/discussions/6921

i think we dont record "autocommit" in terms of "isolation level to reset towards" which is why this is happening

```py

from sqlalchemy import create_engine



def test_engine_sqlite(engine):
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        print(
            f"SQLite thinks it's autocommit? {conn.connection.driver_connection.isolation_level is None}"
        )


    with engine.connect() as conn:
        conn.execution_options(isolation_level="SERIALIZABLE")
        print(
            f"SQLite thinks it's autocommit? {conn.connection.driver_connection.isolation_level is None}"
        )


    with engine.connect() as conn:
        print(
            f"SQLite thinks it's autocommit? {conn.connection.driver_connection.isolation_level is None}"
        )

def test_engine_postgresql(engine):
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        print(
            f"postgresql thinks it's autocommit? {conn.connection.driver_connection.autocommit}"
        )


    with engine.connect() as conn:
        conn.execution_options(isolation_level="SERIALIZABLE")
        print(
            f"postgresql thinks it's autocommit? {conn.connection.driver_connection.autocommit}"
        )


    with engine.connect() as conn:
        print(
            f"postgresql thinks it's autocommit? {conn.connection.driver_connection.autocommit}"
        )



works_pg = create_engine("postgresql://scott:tiger@127.0.0.1/test", echo=True).execution_options(isolation_level="AUTOCOMMIT")

fails_pg = create_engine("postgresql://scott:tiger@127.0.0.1/test", echo=True, isolation_level="AUTOCOMMIT")

works_sl = create_engine("sqlite://", echo=True).execution_options(isolation_level="AUTOCOMMIT")

fails_sl = create_engine("sqlite://", echo=True, isolation_level="AUTOCOMMIT")



test_engine_postgresql(works_pg)
test_engine_postgresql(fails_pg)

test_engine_sqlite(works_sl)
test_engine_sqlite(fails_sl)

```

output:

```
postgresql thinks it's autocommit? True
postgresql thinks it's autocommit? False
postgresql thinks it's autocommit? True
postgresql thinks it's autocommit? True
postgresql thinks it's autocommit? False
postgresql thinks it's autocommit? False  # <--- should be True
SQLite thinks it's autocommit? True
SQLite thinks it's autocommit? False
SQLite thinks it's autocommit? True
SQLite thinks it's autocommit? True
SQLite thinks it's autocommit? False
SQLite thinks it's autocommit? False   # <--- should be True

```
